plans.idea: Keep the original leaderboard's left-to-right reading order of brand, then message, then action, but blow it up to fill the tall 4:1 band: a large logo on the left, a dominant headline column in the middle, and a properly sized CTA on the right, all on one shared horizontal centre line.

Lead with the message: a big headline and subhead block takes the left 60%, and the brand sign-off sits in a right-hand column with the logo stacked over the CTA on one centred axis, so the eye reads headline, then brand, then action.

A symmetric centred composition: a small logo at the top centre, a wide headline and subhead band across the middle, and the CTA centred below, all on one vertical axis with generous dark space on both sides, like a hero banner.
